name: io.github.ipvolt/proxy-toolkit
title: ipvolt Proxy Toolkit
description: Proxy guides, tested configurations and error diagnostics, with an optional local route check.

environmentVariables.name: IPVOLT_ENABLE_ROUTE_CHECK
environmentVariables.description: Optional local route diagnostic. Set 1 only when you want the extra tool to make a bounded request through your configured proxy.

environmentVariables.name: IPVOLT_PROXY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Private HTTP proxy URL, required only when the local route diagnostic is enabled. Supply through the client's local secret environment; never as a tool argument.
